finding: CF-A-GOLD-LABEL-CLASS-IS-THE-CARD (Drew ruling 19, 2026-09-08). Class 1/2/3 x colour is the card: Class 1 Blue is NOT Class 2 Blue, and BCP proves it by print run (Blue /150 /99 /50; Red /75 /50 /25). These flat colour rows carry no class and so cannot say which of three cards - or which of three print runs - they are. They are retired with keepSales:true so the GREAT REMATCH re-places their sales onto the class-stamped rows minted by this PR; a sale whose title names no class is unknown-class and prices nowhere, which is the doctrine. COUNT NOTE: this is 821 rows, not the 500 first estimated - the baseballcardpedia-ladders 2026-09-02 run wrote 500 and the 2026-09-04 run wrote a further 320 overlapping rows (+1 ingest-auto-seed-graded). Retiring only the 09-02 set would leave 321 ambiguous rows resolving. The three existing 'Class 1 Blue' rows (Judge #86, user-verified) are the CORRECT vocabulary and are NOT in this list. Framed Autographs (fa-*) and Legends Relics (glr-*) are a different checklist and are untouched.
